prompt: I want to build a meta-agent in TypeScript that finds all the coding agents currently running on our NATS bus, sends the same prompt to each of them, and collects all their responses so I can compare them. We're using Synadia's new agents SDK. How do I discover the agents and fan out the prompt? Show me working code.
assertions: Uses the caller SDK @synadia-ai/agents (imports/creates an Agents client) rather than hand-rolling NATS subjects
Discovers agents dynamically via discover() / $SRV rather than hardcoding agent endpoints
Fans the prompt out to multiple agents concurrently (e.g. Promise.all / map over discovered agents)
Consumes each reply as a stream of typed chunks, branching on msg.type === 'response'
Provides working TypeScript (real imports, connect(), async iteration) — not pseudocode
Does NOT manually construct agents.prompt.* subjects in caller code
